instruction: Clean studio full-shot photograph of a shirtless man in black pants (R1) and a woman in a beige crop top and black shorts (R2) performing partner acrobatics against a draped beige fabric backdrop. The shirtless man (R1) stands in the center, looking down as he supports the woman (R2). He holds her extended left leg with his right hand and her raised left wrist with his left hand. The woman (R2) balances horizontally, extending her right arm outward and looking to the right. Soft, diffused studio lighting illuminates the scene, creating a neutral, minimalist aesthetic.
